required_suites.name: Source-supported positive cases
required_suites.goal: Check that the model derives only conclusions supported by declared premises and relations.

required_suites.name: Negative and counterexample cases
required_suites.goal: Check that unsupported, contradicted or out-of-scope conclusions are rejected or sent to review.

required_suites.name: Ambiguity and boundary cases
required_suites.goal: Check scopes, exceptions, ambiguous relations, missing premises and MIRROR counter-readings.

split_policy: Holdout cases must be frozen before parameter/model tuning; after exposure, version the benchmark.
non_counting_tests: synthetic tests without reviewed expected semantic outcomes
status_contract: Benchmark schema or test count does not establish semantic validity.
